set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/home
trap 'find /work/target/debug/deps -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "recalld-*" -perm /111 -exec sha256sum {} \; > /work/output/executables.sha256; sha256sum -c /work/output/source.sha256 --quiet > /work/output/source-after.txt; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events > /work/output/memory-events.txt; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak > /work/output/memory-peak.txt' EXIT
sha256sum -c /work/output/source.sha256 --quiet || exit 91
rustc -Vv > /work/output/rustc.txt
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > /work/output/started.txt
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 600s cargo fmt --all -- --check > /work/output/fmt.log 2>&1
fmt_result=$?
printf '%s\n' "$fmt_result" > /work/output/fmt.exit
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 600s cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-features --all-targets > /work/output/clippy.log 2>&1
clippy_result=$?
printf '%s\n' "$clippy_result" > /work/output/clippy.exit
result=$clippy_result
if [ "$fmt_result" -ne 0 ]; then result=$fmt_result; fi
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > /work/output/finished.txt
exit "$result"
